recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. Broader FamilyMemberHistory guidance should be handled under separate final decisions, not by changing the already-applied FHIR-17682 wording.
issue_request: FHIR-17682 asked to change the FamilyMemberHistory notes heading from "Reviewed, None Identified for a Family Member" to "Reviewed, No Information Available for a Family Member" because the old wording sounded too much like a no-known-history statement.
initial_application: Commit 0b584258d4f5ad42f6385524e2c02866ea6c878e on 2019-02-18 explicitly included GF#17682 and changed that exact heading in source/familymemberhistory/familymemberhistory-notes.xml. Current blame still attributes the corrected heading to that commit.
additional_context: FamilyMemberHistory is active in source/fhir.ini, so the notes file is in current build scope. Later Applied issue FHIR-55325 amended the same paragraph to mention FamilyMemberHistory.status health-unknown while preserving the FHIR-17682 heading. FHIR-32901 discusses broader List-versus-FamilyMemberHistory guidance but remains Triaged and is not a final reversal.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/familymemberhistory/familymemberhistory-notes.xml already says "Reviewed, No Information Available for a Family Member", and the obsolete exact heading "Reviewed, None Identified for a Family Member" is not present in current source.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied Patient Care issue updated the same paragraph to mention health-unknown status while retaining the FHIR-17682 heading.
